<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SignUp" name="Subscription sign-up request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Updates" name="Update or renewal notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Cancel" name="Cancellation request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Service" name="Subscription Service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SignUp" name="Sign-up with personal and payment information" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SignUp" messageRef="Msg_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Updates" name="Notification" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Updates"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Cancel" name="Cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="CatchEvent_Cancel" messageRef="Msg_Cancel"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Loop_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_Cancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SignUp" messageRef="Msg_SignUp"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateAccount" name="Generate account and assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Join" name="Subscription running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Loop_Back</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send update, enhancement or renewal notification" messageRef="Msg_Updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Split" name="Customer requested cancellation?" default="Flow_Loop_Back">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Loop_Back</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Cancel" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Cancel" messageRef="Msg_Cancel"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Split" name="Refund due under terms?" default="Flow_Charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Charge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Charge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Merge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_CreateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CreateAccount" targetRef="Task_StartBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_StartBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Join" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel" name="Cancel" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="CatchEvent_Cancel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Loop_Back" name="Continue subscription" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Cancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge" name="Charge applies" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerSignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterPersonal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterPersonal" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_3" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_4" sourceRef="SendTask_SignUp" targetRef="EndEvent_SignUpSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_5" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerCancel" targetRef="SendTask_Cancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CFlow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_Cancel" targetRef="EndEvent_CancelSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Signup_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Signup_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Loop_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRegular</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendEnhancements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRenewal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CatchEvent_Cancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Sign-up request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SignUp" messageRef="Msg_SignUp"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Signup_Split" name="Start account setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Signup_Join" name="Account setup complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Subscription running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRegular" name="Send regular updates" messageRef="Msg_Updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEnhancements" name="Send product enhancements" messageRef="Msg_Enhancements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRenewal" name="Send renewal notifications" messageRef="Msg_Renewal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Split" name="Customer requested cancellation?" default="Flow_Continue">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Cancel" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Cancel" messageRef="Msg_Cancel"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Split" name="Refund due under terms?" default="Flow_Charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Charge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Charge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Merge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Gateway_Signup_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Signup_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Gateway_Signup_Split" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Signup_Split" targetRef="Task_StartBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Signup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_Signup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_StartBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Signup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Signup_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendRegular"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SendRegular" targetRef="Task_SendEnhancements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SendEnhancements" targetRef="Task_SendRenewal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_SendRenewal" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel" name="Cancel" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="CatchEvent_Cancel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue" name="Continue subscription" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Cancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge" name="Charge applies" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Subscribe</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPersonalInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPaymentInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Activate_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Activate_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Running_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendEnhancements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRenewal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Terms_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Subscribe" name="Subscription process begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignUp" name="Sign up for subscription service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPersonalInfo" name="Enter personal information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPaymentInfo" name="Enter payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Activate_Split" name="Start account setup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Activate_Join" name="Account setup complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Running_Merge" name="Subscription running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendEnhancements" name="Send product enhancements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRenewal" name="Send renewal notifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Split" name="Customer decides to cancel?" default="Flow_Continue">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitCancel" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Cancel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Split" name="Refund due under terms?" default="Flow_Charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refund</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Charge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Charge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Terms_Merge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Subscribe" targetRef="Task_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterPersonalInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_EnterPersonalInfo" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Activate_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Activate_Split" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Activate_Split" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Gateway_Activate_Split" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Activate_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Gateway_Activate_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Activate_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Activate_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Running_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Running_Merge" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Task_SendEnhancements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_SendEnhancements" targetRef="Task_SendRenewal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_SendRenewal" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel" name="Cancel" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Task_SubmitCancel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue" name="Continue subscription" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Running_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCancel" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge" name="Charge applies" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Terms_Merge" targetRef="Task_Deactivate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_Deactivate" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
